note: Independent re-judgment against RFC 5176 Section 3.5 and HEAD code (coa.go). TestRFC5176InvalidEAPPacketCauseNeverSent drives all 15 coaResponsePaths covering all four response codes, verifies exact code and Error-Cause per path, and forbids Error-Cause 202 everywhere. TestRFC5176InvalidEAPPacketCauseNeverSentForAnEAPRequest injects Error-Cause 202 into CoA and Disconnect (plus Proxy-State TLV) asserting [401] only and intact Proxy-State, and sends a malformed EAP-Message in Disconnect asserting Error-Cause [401], never 202.
